snippets.lit:
import '@design-schema/lit';
import { html } from 'lit';
import type { DataGridColumn } from '@design-schema/lit';

const columns: DataGridColumn[] = [
  { key: 'sku', header: 'SKU', isRowHeader: true, width: 120, pinned: 'start' },
  { key: 'name', header: 'Name', width: 200, resizable: true, editable: true, editor: 'text' },
  {
    key: 'price',
    header: 'Price (USD)',
    align: 'end',
    sortable: true,
    editable: true,
    editor: 'number',
    width: 120,
    validate: (value) => (typeof value === 'number' && value >= 0 ? undefined : 'Enter a price of 0 or more.'),
  },
  { key: 'qty', header: 'Qty', abbr: 'Quantity', align: 'end', sortable: true, width: 80 },
  {
    key: 'category',
    header: 'Category',
    width: 160,
    editable: true,
    editor: 'select',
    options: [
      { value: 'hardware', label: 'Hardware' },
      { value: 'software', label: 'Software' },
    ],
  },
  { key: 'inStock', header: 'In stock', width: 96, editable: true, editor: 'checkbox' },
];

html`
      <ds-data-grid
        caption="Price list"
        caption-level="2"
        .columns=${columns}
        .data=${Array.from({ length: 2000 }, (_, i) => ({
    id: \`r${i}\`,
    sku: \`S-${i + 1}\`,
    name: \`Item ${i + 1}\`,
    price: (i % 40) + 1,
    qty: i % 50,
    category: i % 2 === 0 ? 'hardware' : 'software',
    inStock: i % 3 !== 0,
  }))}
        .rowCount=
        .sort=
        .defaultSort=
        selectable=none
        .selected=
        ?editable=
        density=compact
        ?no-sticky-header=
        height=viewport
        ?loading=
        empty-message=
        ?no-status-bar=
      ></ds-data-grid>
`;
